in_marathi.name: Eshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshwar is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ishvara’ which means ‘Lord of the Universe’. In Hinduism, Ishvara is the supreme god, the ruler of all creation. Eshwar is a revered name for boys, symbolizing power, authority, and devotion to the divine.
